info.title: Tommy, la stella dei Giants
info.synopsis: Hoshi Ittetsu era un giocatore di baseball molto dotato, ormai prossimo al passaggio al professionismo, quando lo scoppio della seconda guerra mondiale costrinse il giovane atleta ad arruolarsi. Alla conclusione della guerra, a causa di una grave ferita, i lanci di Ittetsu erano diventati lenti e deboli, e poco era rimasto del grande campione del passato. Nemmeno l'invenzione di un nuovo lancio ad effetto fu sufficiente, in quando la sua eccessiva pericolosità sancì la sua estromissione dalla squadra. Impossibilitato a raggiungere il suo obiettivo personalmente, Ittetsu proietta le sue ossessioni sul figlio secondogenito Hyuma, anch'egli appassionato di baseball, che inizia a sottoporre ad allenamenti massacranti fin dalla più tenera età.

info.title: Super Robot Wars OG: The Inspector
info.synopsis: Sono trascorsi sei mesi dalla fine del precedente conflitto e i piloti che hanno combattuto per proteggere la Terra hanno ormai preso strade separate. Ma la pace non sembra destinata a durare a lungo. I membri rimasti dei Divine Crusaders hanno cominciato a riorganizzarsi e a lanciare attacchi verso la Federazione Terrestre, supportati da un'organizzazione misteriosa chiamata Shadow Mirror, che ha a sua disposizione tecnologie belliche apparentemente impossibili da replicare. Allo stesso tempo creature interdimensionali chiamate Einst cominciano ad apparire in tutto il mondo, lasciando una scia di distruzione lungo il loro cammino. Persino le forze terrestri stazionate sulla White Star, la base degli invasori alieni ormai sconfitti, vengono improvvisamente annichilite dall'attacco degli Inspector, un gruppo di esseri provenienti dallo spazio profondo intenzionati a soggiogare la Terra prima che diventi un pericolo troppo grande. Di fronte a così tante minacce, gli eroi della guerra passata dovranno di nuovo unire tutte le loro forze per proteggere il pianeta.

episodes.title: Red Impact
episodes.synopsis: In the era known as "New A.D., six months after the "DC War" against the military organization "Divine Crusaders', and the "L5 Campaign" against the extraterrestrial foes known as "Aerogaters"... Lt. Kyosuke Nanbu's Earth Federation PT Squad "The ATX Team" heads to the far east to defeat the survivors of DC. In the middle of the fight, he and his partner Excellen witness the sudden arrival of a new humanoid weapon. This new angel-like machine, is it a friend or a foe

episodes.title: Unknown Voice
episodes.synopsis: In the middle of the battle with the remnants of DC, a mysterious woman named Lamia Loveless appears, piloting a Special Unit (A Special Humanoid Mobile Weapon) She has strange problems with her language, and her unknown origins make Kyosuke suspicious. Meanwhile, Archibold's DC forces attack a dig site in China called Shiyu Mound. The federation battlecarrier Shirogane rushes to intercept, and the ATX team, now with Lamia, sorties. Excellent and Bullet are surprised by the strange feeling in the air around the mound. Then strange plantlike monsters appear, as well as a Tiger and Dragon Chokijin

episodes.title: The Cross Borne
episodes.synopsis: A mock battle betweent two prototypes is underway at Izu base. Ryusei of the SRX team is piloting a simplified mass produced version of his own R-1, the R-Blade, and Latouni of the special tactics instruction squad is piloting the Wild Falken, the new unit from the ATX plan. Meanwhile, Archibold's DC forces send Yuki's squad to recover the prototype. Two of the members of his squad are Arado and Seolla, young pilots trained at a special institute called "The School". Latooni, who once attended the school herself, encounters Seolla on the battlefield.

episodes.title: Bonds And Promises
episodes.synopsis: To Latooni, Arado and Seolla are old friends fom the Special training organization "The School". Ryusei and the others meet up with the ATX team, and persue the DC remnants. They're stopped by Seolla in the Wild Falken, and Latooni goes after her, but..

episodes.title: In The Name Of DC
episodes.synopsis: The Shirogane is damaged in its fight with the DC remnants. Kyosuke begins to wonder at the enemy's overwhelming firepower, and suspect the existance of a 3rd party behind the scenes. Meanwhile, at the massive underground Earth Cradle, DC's headquarters, forces are steadily gathering..

episodes.title: Cherry Blossom Phantom
episodes.synopsis: When Alado is shot down by Latooni, he's taken prisoner aboard he Hagane and given treatment for his injuries. Meanwhile, Seolla returns to the Neo-DC base, the "Earth Cradle", and is "recondition" by Aguilla Setome, erasing her memories of Alado. Aguilla learns that Latooni, who had once given up on Latooni and expelled her from the School, is now fighting for the Federation. She orders the school's top ace, Ouka Nagisa, to recover her

episodes.title: Black Infiltrator
episodes.synopsis: A blue special unit appears in front of the Hagane's pilots. It's pilot calls Kyosuke "Beowulf". Later, the Hagane stops at Aviano base in the Meditteranian. Tehre, Kyosuke, Excellent, Rai, and Latooni are given a mission to guard aparade during an environmental summut in the Dukedom of Riksent. When they arrive, they are greated by princess Shine. Latooni is overjoyed to see her friend again, and Kyosuke and Excellen enjoy a rare date in between their missions, but..

episodes.title: Servants of the Dark Bird
episodes.synopsis: The pilots of the battle carrier "Hiryuu Kai", which fought with the Hagane during the DC and L5 campaigns, are undergoing training. Katrina's Octo Squad, Tasuku, Leona, and Russel, each launch in their own units. Meanwhile, the space fortress "White Star", formerly the base of the aerogaters that attacked the earth, is attacked by a mysterious force. The force also appears at the Mao Industiries moonbase, and Ryoto, Rio, and Rin, who are loading a new unit for transport, recieve a message. "Hand over the Huckebein.

episodes.title: Inspector
episodes.synopsis: The enemies that attacked the White Star in the L5 area were a different group of aliens than the Aerogaters. They used teleportation to launch a surprise attack on the Federation's North American military facilities, and succeed in taking them over. The Tesla Reich Labs, where the Special Units and Project TD's new mechs are being built, is no exception, and it is surrounded by alien mobile weapons. Kusuha, Ibis, and Sleigh attempt to escape with the new mechs, but they are met by a bizarre looking foe. Its pilot calls this new enemy the "Inspectors"..

episodes.title: A Fairy Dances in the Moonlight
episodes.synopsis: The Inspectors have taken over the major military bases of the North American Reion, and the Federation Government and military are plunged into chaos. Meanwhile, Archibold of the Neo D.C. forces takes over the Riksent Duchey to secure military funds. The Battle Carrier Hiryuu Kai has descended to Earth, and met up with the Hagane. Kyosuke, Excellen, and the other pilots launch a mission to recover Riksent from Neo DC. Rai, whose sister in law was killed by Archibold, corners him enraged, but the group is endangered. Then Latooni and Shine's new armored modules, the Fairlions, appear..

episodes.title: The Harpe Sickle
episodes.synopsis: The Earth Federation begins "Operation Plantagenet" to sweep the Inspectors from North America. Neo-DC joins the force, and Kyosuke's former enemies now become his allies. Also, Marion Ladam realises the hidden potential Alado carries, and makes him the pilot of the new Wild Wurger. Meanwhile, High-ranking Federation beauracrat Glassman, North American Theatre Commander Kenneth Garrett, and Isurugi Heavy Industries CEO continue their conspiracy..

episodes.title: Shadow Mirror
episodes.synopsis: Despite the cease-fire with Neo-DC, the Federation's Izu base comes under attack. Suspecting a plot, Kyosuke and Excellen launch a counterattack. Alado finds Seolla among the attackers, and launches in the Wild Wurger himself. But Aguila Setme's reconditioning has caused her to forget Alado, and she tries to defeat him. Latooni and Shine work together with him, but Ouka appears in her Rapiecage. Then Lamia's Angelg points its main weapon at the Hagane's bridge. Just what is she planning

episodes.title: Exiles From Paradise
episodes.synopsis: Vindel and Lemon's Shadow Mirror forces have been working with Neo-DC. After the sneak attack on Izu, they are stopped by three black mechs. Retzel's Garbine Mk-3 Tronbe, Sanger's Grungust Type-3, and Giliam's Geschpenst Type RV. Giliam attacks their mothership the Ganland to destroy Shadow Mirror's teleporter, System XN. Vindel orders his men to capture Giliam. How are the two connected

episodes.title: With Those Pure Eyes
episodes.synopsis: Giliam and Lamia tell the rest of the team the true identity of Shadow Mirror. They are from a parallel world, and have come here using the dimension/space teleporter "System XN". They plan to bring about endless, controlled conflict, securing for themselves a reason for existence and humanity a means of advancement. Operation Plantagenet begins, and the Hagane and Hiryuu Custom head for Hawaii. During their approach, a girl calling herself Alfemi suddenly appears and speaks to Kyosuke and Excellen. Who is she, and what does she wan

episodes.title: War God`s Armament "DyGenGuar"
episodes.synopsis: Sanger in his Grungust Type-3 and Retzel's Mark-3 Tronbe appear at the Tesla Reich Laboratories, now under the control of the Inspectors. The Inspector Vigagi tries to stop them with his Gulgaw. Outnumbered and overpowered, the Grungust is badly damaged and Sanger is gravely endangered. Then, a Special Unit apepars from the underground hanger on the lowest level of the labs. Its name is the "Dynamic General Guardian." Sanger tries to get inside it, but.

episodes.title: Only One Crash
episodes.synopsis: The SRX team's Mai Kobayashi, who had lost her memories, learns that she was once the leader of the Aerogater forces who attacked earth, Levi Tolar. As if rushing in through a crack in her wounded heart, the remanants of Levi's mind increase in strength. Mai leaves the Hagane in the R-Gun Powered, as if being led by Levi. She is met by Neo-DC, who attack her despite the cease-fire. The leader of the Neo-DC forces is Aguila Setme, who knows another secret about her past..

episodes.title: Steel Cry
episodes.synopsis: The operation to defeat the Inspectors, Operation Plantagenet, nears its end, as the Federation Carries Hagane and Hiryuu Custom meat with Colonel Van Vat Tran of Neo-DC to attack the Inspectors at Langley base. They're met by Mekibos, one of the Inspector leaders. After a brutal battle, Kyosuke and Excellen succeed in breaking through the enemy's defensive lines, but shadow Mirror forces teleport in in front of them. They had secretly made an alliance with the Inspectors. And then the Shadow Mirror flagship, the Ganrand, aims its guns at the Hagane..

episodes.title: The Inviting Fires of Demons
episodes.synopsis: After escaping from the Inspectors, Shadow Mirror, and the mysterious monster, the captain of the Hagane, Daitetsu, falls. Excellen and the Weissritter are captured by the monsters, and Kyosuke is wounded in his battle with Axel, and his Alt Eisen crippled. The monsters, who are now called "Einst", attack military bases all over the world, causing even further chaos. Meanwhile, Excellen and the Weissritter are changed by Alfemi. What are the Einst after

episodes.title: RyuKohOh Appears
episodes.synopsis: The appearance of the Einst has plunged the Earth into Chaos, and the Federation, Neo-DC, and the Inspectors reach a stalemate. Meanwhile, Einst attack the Canadian city of Winnipeg. The Hiryuu Custom rushes to the area, but is stopped by Alfemi and a changed WEiss Ritter. Bullet and Kusuha launch in the Grungust Type-3, and when they arrive they feel an evil energy in Winnipeg. Its source is a massive Einst. As they struggle against it, the Chokijin RyuKohOh appears

episodes.title: The Young Raptor
episodes.synopsis: The Neo-DC base Earth Cradle has been strangely silent since Operation Plantagenet. Archibold and Aguila, who care nothing for Colonel Van's wishes, have been hiding there. Captain Lefina of the Hiryuu Custom decides that there is a high probability the Earth Cradle will be used as the Inspector's new planetside base, and goes to investigate. Ouka, Seolla, and the Machinery Children approach them. Alado flies out in his Wild Wurger. Will his love reach Seolla, with her memories rewritten

episodes.title: Rest in the Cradle
episodes.synopsis: The Hiryuu Custom fights a fierce battle with Neo-DC in the Earth Cradle. The Kurogane attempts a charge. Sanger and his Dygenguar fight a final battle against Wodan and his Thrudgelmir. Raidiese and Retzel find their arch-enemy Archibold and begin the battle they've waited for for so long. And Ouka, given a powerful reconditioning by Setme, attacks the rest of the children from the School..

episodes.title: It Is by Knowing the Time to Fall
episodes.synopsis: Aguila's reconditioning has turned Ouka into a battle machine. Her Rapieçage Fantome overwhelmes the School children. Cuervo Cero makes an attempt to revive her memories. Meanwhile something strange was happening throughout the Earth Cradle. The activated machine cells repaired the damaged enemy units, and stopped the SRX-team dead in their tracks. And above the gate of Magus, the Dygenguar and Thrudgelmir face off, ready to use their ultimate techniques

episodes.title: The Heart of a Fallen Angel
Pierce Faster than He
episodes.synopsis: Something strange happens to the White Star, and the ruler of the Einst, Neu Regisseur, teleports in. The heroes are shocked at its size. Neu Regisseur begins to change the Earth into a world for the Einst to live in, and more Einst appear. The ATX team, Dygenguar and the Aussenseiter charge in to stop them, but..

info.title: Pokemon Movie 01: Mew contro Mewtwo
info.synopsis: In un laboratorio per esperimenti genetici è in corso il progetto Mewtwo, ovvero il tentativo di clonare da pochi frammenti di DNA, una versione migliorata di un pokémon antico ritenuto ormai estinto. L'esperimento ha successo e Mewtwo, in quanto creato sulla base di un pokémon di tipo psyco è dotato di enormi poteri psichici, superiori a quelli di qualsiasi umano o pokèmon del pianeta. L'inteliggente creatura si pone imprevedibilmente domande sul perché della propria esistenza, ma non riesce a darsi una risposta. Frustrato da quell'incertezza, l'unica cosa che gli è chiara e che merita ben di più di essere una cavia per quegli scienziati e convinto della natura corrotta degli esseri umani e della debolezza dei pokémon che li seguono, metterà in atto un piano di conquista che gli farà incrociare la sua strada con quelle di Ash, Pikachu, Brock e Misty.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: Ash Ketchum and friends are tricked into visiting New Island, an island ruled by a mutant Pokémon, Mewtwo. There, they find out about Mewtwo's plans to clone their Pokémon and destroy the world, and a massive battle follows between the clones and the originals - including the "original" counterpart to Mewtwo: Mew.

info.title: Ragazze di successo (ITA)
info.synopsis: La serie racconta la storia di Mimi Kitagami, popolare e amata rappresentante di classe il cui sogno è diventare la miglior rappresentante che la scuola abbia mai conosciuto. Tutto sembra andare per il meglio, ma Mimi ha un unico grosso problema, ossia, tre problematici studenti della sua classe che non sono per niente intenzionati a seguire le regole. Riuscirà Mimi a tenere testa al diabolico trio? Le cose a poco a poco cambieranno per entrambe le parti e la nostra protagonista riuscirà a vedere quanto di buono c'è in ognuno di loro.

episodes.title: È estate! Tutti al campo scuola
La ragazza del club del coro
La finale del concorso di bellezza
Karen scioglie il Princess Rose Club

info.title: Pass the Monster Meat, Milady!
info.synopsis: Come ogni vera nobildonna, bisogna acquisire un certo buon gusto. Nel caso di Melphiera Marchalrayd capita di desiderare una proteina piuttosto esotica: la carne di mostro! Ma non giudicate, nonostante la pessima reputazione questo alimento può essere utilizzato per realizzare dei piatti veramente squisiti e Melpheria è intenzionata a cambiare l'opinione dell'intero regno. Sfortunamente, da quando ha debuttato nella società, ha cercato un partner perfetto che condividesse la sua passione non riuscendoci... fino a quando non ha incontrato il folle e sanguinario conte di Galbraith!

episodes.title: A Jerky Is a Promise: Skatzbitt
episodes.synopsis: Melphiera is old enough to find a husband, but she's more interested in cooking... monsters.

episodes.title: A Proposal from Above with a Gift
episodes.synopsis: The duke visits Melphie in Marchalrayd's lands to ask for her hand in marriage.

episodes.title: Grilled Skewers of Prime Meat: Royal Moodle
episodes.synopsis: Melphie demonstrates how to prepare a royal moodle for consumption.

episodes.title: Signaling Departure with a Pillar of Flame
episodes.synopsis: Melphie accepts the Duke's proposal and prepares to move to the Galbraith family's lands.

episodes.title: Night at Fort Ritterd
episodes.synopsis: Melphie and the Duke spend the night at Fort Ritterd on their way to Galbraith's lands.

episodes.title: In Season: Battered and Deep-Fried Monster Fish
episodes.synopsis: Melphie fries up a fish monster for the Duke and his knights.

episodes.title: Those Who Inherit the Galbraith Name
episodes.synopsis: The Duke tells Melphie about his upbringing as they approach Galbraith's lands.

episodes.title: Uses for Cloudy Quartz
episodes.synopsis: Melphie devises a clever way to deal with a flock of bird monsters.

episodes.title: The Voracious Villainess`s Resolve
episodes.synopsis: Melphie gets her first taste of her new life in Middlaeg.

episodes.title: The Blood-Mad Duke`s Intentions
episodes.synopsis: Melphie asks the Duke to bring her the fruit of a screamwood.

episodes.title: Sweet or Sour Fruit
episodes.synopsis: Melphie and the Blanche Corps share a screamwood fruit, and the Duke presents Melphie with a second gift.

episodes.title: The Voracious Villainess`s First Appearance
episodes.synopsis: Melphiera does her best to make a good first impression on the people of Galbraith.

info.title: Ragna Crimson (ITA)
info.synopsis: In questa opera dark fantasy pregna di azione, l'umanità vive temendo di essere annientata a causa di draghi immensamente potenti. Ragna, il cacciatore di draghi, inizia il suo viaggio per vendicarsi ed eradicare questa minaccia una volta per tutte!

episodes.title: The Day the Reaper Was Born
episodes.synopsis: Death and fire haunt Ragna's dreams, and deep within his heart, he somehow knows they're omens. If he doesn't grow stronger, and soon, all that awaits him is lifelong regret.

episodes.title: The Beginning of the Story
episodes.synopsis: Temruogtaf must be stopped. But Ragna loses interest in the dragon and turns his attention to one of his maids. Thanks to his new old memories, he knows who she really is.

episodes.title: Agitation
episodes.synopsis: Crimson is no hero. He will manipulate and use others if it furthers his goal, and that callousness is precisely what makes him a needed ally against dragons.

episodes.title: Action
episodes.synopsis: Dragons have another weakness aside from sunlight and silverine: pride. But Ultimatia is not like other dragons.

episodes.title: Wing
episodes.synopsis: Ragna met Ultimatia before in another life and he did not emerge from that encounter unscathed. Now, in this life, dragons are disappearing and Ultimatia needs to know why.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.synopsis: Ultimatia may have control over time itself, but Crimson knows her powers must have a weakness. Uncover it, and all variables will be accounted for. Or so Crimson thinks.

episodes.title: Act and Guilt
episodes.synopsis: Ragna’s relentless assault forces Ultimatia on the defensive. Unaware of his identity, an unexpected emotion overtakes the dragon monarch as their battle rages on: Fear.

episodes.title: A Painful Blow
episodes.synopsis: Ultimatia made an impossible choice and, with Nebulim out for their blood, Ragna and Crimson must now withdraw. However, they may have only exchanged one problem for another.

episodes.title: Negotiation and True Nature
episodes.synopsis: Starlia's ability to see a person’s true nature puts Crimson at a disadvantage, but when Ragna suddenly appears, the princess sees something in him she’s never seen before.

episodes.title: Stakes and Cooperation
episodes.synopsis: While Crimson uses Ragna as a bargaining chip to convince Starlia to accept their aid, Woltekamui vows to remain at Ultimatia’s side and gives her much needed encouragement.

episodes.title: Tactics and Knowledge
episodes.synopsis: Ragna spars with the Argentum Corps and infuses their weapons while Crimson assists with the teleportation circles. But they are not the only ones preparing for battle.

episodes.title: Determination and Readiness
episodes.synopsis: The battle begins at sunset, but before they confront an uncertain fate, Starlia asks Ragna to listen to a heartfelt request.

episodes.title: Hero of the Battle
episodes.synopsis: The battle has begun, but Ragna and the Argentum Corps are not facing just any enemy. They are facing those who mean to exterminate them by any means necessary.

episodes.title: Impatience and Vigilance
episodes.synopsis: Olto Zora's cunning plan overwhelms the corps as they face the power of mature dragons. However, Crimson's impending offensive and Starlia's resolve may be the key to victory.

episodes.title: Latent Awakening
episodes.synopsis: The tide is turning as the corps claw their way through the battlefield—Ragna and Starlia the source of their inspiration. But none are aware of Crimson's callous scheme.

episodes.title: Will of Resistance
episodes.synopsis: Olto Zora used to be someone else once, and Starlia reminds him of someone he knew long ago.

episodes.title: My Comrade
episodes.synopsis: Olto Zora and Taratectra are lifelong friends who stand at a crossroads that could determine the battle. Now, Ragna and Starlia may be the only ones who can prevent calamity.

episodes.title: End of the Battle to the Death
episodes.synopsis: The battle is over, but at a heavy price. While a weary corps mourn their losses, representatives from the Solarian Church arrive to meet the fabled Reaper.

episodes.title: Reason to Fight
episodes.synopsis: Ragna has found a reason to fight, and he and the Argentum Corps will take the battle to the Blood of the Wing, no matter what Crimson thinks.

episodes.title: Just Watch Me
episodes.synopsis: Four superior dragons stand between them and the Winged Monarch. With unyielding resolve, the Argentum Corps storm a dead capital for the final battle.

episodes.title: Words Aren`t Needed
episodes.synopsis: Multiple battles erupt in an all-out war against the Blood of the Wing. As each side engages in mortal combat, a crucial decision awaits Crimson.

episodes.title: The Winged Monarch
episodes.synopsis: The darkest hour is at hand. As cherished comrades fall on both sides, bittersweet memories of the past surge to the forefront.

episodes.title: Lightning God
episodes.synopsis: As Ragna and Woltekamui's titanic battle rages across the heavens, the dragon is reminded of another encounter—one that shaped him into the warrior he is today.

episodes.title: Light
episodes.synopsis: Just as Ragna, Crimson and the Argentum Corps stand at the cusp of victory, the worst case scenario occurs: Against all odds, Ultimatia reclaims her dominion over time.

info.title: Kujima: Why Sing, When You Can Warble?
info.synopsis: Nell'autunno del suo primo anno delle medie, Arata Kо̄da incontra una bizzarra creatura simile ad un uccello che si presenta come Kujima. Vedendolo affamato, il ragazzo decide di portarlo a casa per dargli qualcosa da mangiare. Qui Kujima farà conoscenza con il fratello maggiore di Arata, che vive da recluso per dedicarsi al massimo nello studio per l'esame d'ammissione. Dopo un confronto teso Kujima decide di rimanere in questa casa per tutto l'inverno, aiutando la famiglia fino a quando non giungerà la primavera. Come andrà questa strana convivenza?

episodes.title: The First Blin You Make Will Be a Lump
episodes.synopsis: Kouda Arata meets Kujima, a bird-like creature from Russia. Kujima starts living with the Koudas.

episodes.title: A Crow Imitating a Cormorant
episodes.synopsis: There are rumors of a ghost in the neighborhood. Could they be about Kujima, or...?

episodes.title: No Two Birds Are Born with the Same Feather
episodes.synopsis: Kujima is introduced to Makoto, Arata's friend. Later, Kujima takes photos with the Koudas for the first time.

episodes.title: The Bird from the North Builds Its Nest on a Northern Branch
episodes.synopsis: Kujima gets homesick and decides to go home. Arata has an idea to make Kujima feel more at home, but...?

episodes.title: Truth Comes Out of Falsehood
episodes.synopsis: Kujima experiences the kotatsu table and then Christmas for the first time in Japan.

episodes.title: First Mt. Fuji, Second Kujima, Third Eggplant

info.title: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked
info.synopsis: Dopo la morte della madre, Miya scopre di essere la figlia illegittima di un nobile e viene accolta nella prestigiosa famiglia Kōnokura. Convinta di finire in una classica fiaba da Cenerentola con matrigna e sorellastre crudeli, scopre invece una famiglia gentile e premurosa, decisa a farla sentire a casa. Timida e affetta da antropofobia, Miya fatica ad adattarsi alla nuova vita e all’ambiente scolastico elitario. Tuttavia, grazie all’affetto della sua rigida ma dolce matrigna Teru e delle sue due sorellastre, la seria Marika e la riservata Arisa, inizia a superare le proprie insicurezze e scoprire un nuovo senso di appartenenza.

episodes.title: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren`t Wicked
episodes.synopsis:
Miya Nakamura lived a humble but happy life with her beloved mother. 
But when her mother passes away, Miya is taken in by the prestigious Kounokura family. 
Expecting rejection as the child of a mistress, Miya prepares for the worst. Instead, she's welcomed with open arms by her caring stepsisters, 
who pamper her with affection and even transform her father's study into a room of her own.

episodes.title: The Kounokura Family`s Guard
episodes.synopsis:
Still adjusting to life in the Kounokura household, Miya is told to greet the family's guardian. Expecting a fearsome soldier, she's stunned to meet Gungnir: a tiny, fluffy dog. 
Instantly charmed, Miya soon learns he lost his bark because of a tragic past. 
As she uncovers his story, she finds painful parallels with her own.

episodes.title: Daughters of Distinguished Families
episodes.synopsis: Miya is struggling to keep up with her studies under Marika's guidance, but grows discouraged when her hard work doesn't pay off. To cheer her up, Marika opens up about her own past, helping Miya realize she's not alone. Just as the mood begins to lift, Arisa arrives to insist it's time for a break. But on their way to enjoy some tea on the terrace, a loud crash suddenly echoes from the garden…

episodes.title: Miya Returning a Favor
episodes.synopsis: A month after joining the Kounokura family, Miya wants to find a way to repay their kindness. She offers to help when Marika and the others receive new clothes, but somehow ends up picking out outfits for herself too. But Miya decides to focus on the plan to repay them, and starts turning down Marika and Arisa's invitations to focus on the plan, leaving them to think she's avoiding them.

episodes.title: Miya's First Friend
episodes.synopsis: Thanks to Teru, Miya enrolls at Eihou Girls' Academy alongside Marika and Arisa. Though thrilled to experience school life for the first time, her excitement quickly turns to anxiety when she catches the eye of the school's admired beauty Riru Kazan. Convinced she's somehow offended her, Miya is left bewildered - until Riru unexpectedly appoints her vice leader for their upcoming school excursion.

episodes.title: The Inari Family's Daughter
episodes.synopsis: Miya has settled into life at Eihou Girls' Academy, and meets Koyuki Inari, a classmate who has been absent since the entrance ceremony. Though shy and timid, Koyuki is the eldest daughter of the influential Inari family, whose vast intelligence network earns even Arisa's respect. Drawn to Koyuki's quiet nature, Miya soon discovers she's carrying a secret burden.

episodes.title: The Kounokura Treasure
episodes.synopsis: Miya's cousin Yaeko visits the Kounokura family with a cake to celebrate Miya passing her written exam. While heading to the terrace with Arisa for tea, Yaeko accidentally bumps into Teru, the intimidating main wife of the Kounokura family. Yaeko panicks and desperately tries to make amends for offending the lady of the household - and impulsively invites Teru to join them for tea…?

episodes.title: The Dog Lady
episodes.synopsis: It's Parents' Observation Day at Eihou Girls Academy. The teachers nervously welcome the parents, knowing a single complaint could cost them their jobs. Teru charms the mothers before visiting Marika and Arisa's classes. When she arrives at Miya's, curious looks and whispers follow the girl whose unusual circumstances make her a rarity at school. Under Teru's watch, Miya reads her composition.

episodes.title: A Disciplined and Traditional Student Council
episodes.synopsis: Student Council President Sadame Mikuriya is respected for her strict adherence to school rules. Though Miya wonders if she is mistaken, the girl she met walking a dog in the park bears a striking resemblance to Sadame. The Student Council reviews a Parents' Day survey on concerns over Miya's enrollment as the child of a mistress - but strangely, none of her classmates' parents have voiced them.

episodes.title: Battle of the Maidens
episodes.synopsis: Sports Day has arrived. Sadame and Marika face off in the sprint, while Miya's Aquilegia Team falls behind Team Rindo. Determined to win at any cost, Miya enters the scavenger hunt - only to find Marika and Arisa among the contestants. Despite their efforts, Aquilegia struggles to close the gap. Recharged by Teru's special bento, Miya is ready to give it her all in the afternoon… but then…

episodes.title: Memories of Summer
episodes.synopsis: During summer break, Teru takes the family to the beach. While Marika and Arisa are excited, Miya feels uneasy because of painful memories from the past. Teru's words help her relax, and she begins to enjoy the sea. There, they run into Riru and student council members Homare and Takiko. The group heads to the Kounokura beach house, where Marika and Arisa soon start bickering again.

episodes.title: Dear Mother
episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation is over, and the new school term begins. But Miya is absent, sick with a fever. Riru and Koyuki, along with Arisa and Marika, worry about her. As Arisa remembers the day Miya first came to the Kounokura household, Teru and the others care for Miya at home. Feverish and barely conscious, Miya hears a familiar voice calling her name... Her mother's.

info.title: Magic Knight Rayearth (2026)
info.synopsis: Hikaru, Umi e Fuu, tre ragazze provenienti da scuole diverse, si incontrano durante una gita alla Tokyo Tower e vengono improvvisamente trasportate nel mondo magico di Cephiro, dove la volontà può influenzare la realtà. Qui incontrano Guru Clef, che spiega loro di essere state evocate per salvare la Principessa Emeraude, tenuta prigioniera dal sacerdote Zagato. Per portare a termine la missione, dovranno apprendere la magia, ottenere armi e superare diverse prove lungo il loro cammino.
